primary_failure_mode_caught: Reviews dependency and CVE claims with a bias against overclaiming.

assumptions.posture: Reviews dependency and CVE claims with a bias against overclaiming.

required_inputs: 08 review shard and its upstream and red-team citations
outputs: disposition, rationale and proof-obligation status for each reviewed item
must_not: refute a dependency claim on version alone without showing the vulnerable code is absent or unloaded
